notes.title: Still Alive! Game Balance Update v1.01
notes.notes:
[b]It's been a while![/b]
Here's a small update changing a few of the starting abilities to make your initial attempts a bit easier!

[u]
Balance Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Reduced Grappling Hook cooldown and increased speed by a small amount
[*] Increased normal Jump strength by a small amount
[*] Reduced Dash cooldown
[*] Removed Spike Death Trap Punishment from Level 1 & 2, shortened Duration in other levels
[/list]

[u]Updated[/u]
[list]
[*] Added new music to Main Menu and almost all Levels
[/list]

GL & HF!

notes.title: Officially Released!
notes.notes:
[h1]Get ready to roll! ball-e is now available on Steam with new features and content![/h1]

Welcome to ball-e, the exciting new roguelike platformer game where you take on various stages and bosses using unique abilities and characters! We are thrilled to announce that ball-e has officially launched on Steam, and we're offering a limited-time discount this week. Don't miss out on the chance to be part of the ball-e community!

If you had a chance to play during the Steam Next Fest, you'll be pleased to know that there's a lot more new things to discover:

[list]
[*] More stages and bosses to conquer
[*] Unlock new abilities and characters for more gameplay variety
[*] More challenges to test your skills
[*] More achievements to earn and show off
[*] Gameplay changes for an even better experience!
[/list]

Feedback is appreciated, so please report any major bugs or balancing issues you encounter on our [url=https://discord.gg/dBJgdyhaPS]Discord [/url] or in the Steam Community Forum. Your feedback helps improve the game and provide a better experience for all players!

Additionally I want to thank all the players and friends who have supported the game during the development and Steam Next Fest. This wouldn't have been possible without you! I hope you enjoy the new features and content in ball-e and have a great time playing. If you have any questions, feedback, or encounter any problems with the game, feel free to reach out to me via Discord or the Steam Community Discussion.

Good luck and have fun rolling your way through ball-e!

Best Regards,
Julian

notes.title: Demo Update v0.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42815708/f96fe9d877d1d45a8e8e557fc70910d3d2bd1412.jpg[/img]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made quite big changes to the movement and physics of the characters as well as the environment
[*] Overall the game is now a tiny bit less colorful and color coded to easier differentiate things on the screen, blue = not deadly/could be helpful, red = don't touch (excluding platforms, for which it means: can be destroyed), this is also reflected on most mini map icons
[*] Improved the collider of the mine ability, making it more reliable to stand on
[*] Adjusted some mini map icon colors and added an icon for speed boosts
[/list]

[h2]Fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some bad textures
[*] Fixed some more minor issues
[/list]
